passport.title: Farm passport
passport.description: Farm details, land documents and responsible people
passport.name: Farm name
passport.overAssignedBody: The contours add up to {{area}} more than the total area. Check the areas.

map.noLocation: The farm's place on the map is not set. Enter its coordinates in Settings.
map.title: Farm map
map.description: Draw fields and facilities on the map. The area is calculated automatically.
map.placePoint: Mark a facility with a point
map.drawHint: Tap the boundary points one by one: {{name}}. Press Finish when you are done.
map.pointHint: Tap the spot on the map where the facility is.
map.editHint: Drag the points to change the boundary.
map.previewArea: Estimated area: {{area}}. The exact area is calculated after saving.
map.overlap: Warning: this contour overlaps №{{number}} by {{area}}. That area counts twice in the land balance.
map.unmappedTitle: Contours not drawn on the map
map.toolsFailed: The drawing tools did not load, so the map is view-only. Try reloading the page.
map.healthEmpty: No clear satellite image of the fields in the last 30 days yet. Images arrive every 2 to 5 days; cloudy days are skipped.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: All land contours: crop fields, pasture, reserve, yard and infrastructure
fields.name: Name
fields.areaManualHint: If you draw it on the map, the area is calculated automatically.
fields.areaFromMapHint: The area is calculated from the boundary on the map.
fields.searchPlaceholder: Search by number, name or soil
fields.emptyBody: Draw your fields on the map, or enter their area by hand.
fields.archiveBody: {{name}} leaves the list. Its history and costs are kept.
fields.noCropBody: Crop plans are assigned in the Crops section.
fields.rotationEmptyBody: Crops, yield and cost for the last 5 years appear here.
fields.soilTextureHint: Sets how much water the soil holds, for the watering advice.

soil.trendHint: Pick an indicator to see how it changes over the years.
soil.emptyBody: Enter laboratory results and their trend appears here.
soil.deleteBody: The analysis of {{date}} will be deleted.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.description: Barn, stores, water, power, roads and the irrigation network
facilities.name: Name
facilities.parentHint: For a section, choose the barn it belongs to.
facilities.emptyBody: Add the barn, stores and other facilities, or draw them on the map.
facilities.archiveBody: {{name}} leaves the list. Records linked to it are kept.

irrigation.name: Name
irrigation.limitHint: Yearly limit. Actual use comes from the irrigation journal.
irrigation.emptyBody: Add canals, ditches, pumps and pipes, and link them to fields.
irrigation.deleteBody: {{name}} will be removed from the network.

documents.title: Document archive
documents.description: Land, construction, permits and contracts. Those about to expire come first.
documents.expiryHint: Leave empty if it does not expire.
documents.emptyBody: Add a document and you will be reminded before it expires.
documents.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be deleted from the archive.

weather.title: Weather forecast
weather.emptyBody: The weather updates automatically every 6 hours.
weather.unavailable: The weather service is not responding. It will update automatically later.
weather.credit: Data: MET Norway (CC BY 4.0), NASA POWER
weather.sprayNone: Spraying: no good daytime hours in the next 2 days (wind, rain or heat)

errors.FIELD_NUMBER_TAKEN: Contour number {{number}} already exists. Choose another number.
errors.AREA_REQUIRED: Draw the field on the map or enter its area.
errors.AREA_FROM_BOUNDARY: The area comes from the map boundary. Remove the boundary to enter it by hand.
errors.INVALID_GEOMETRY: The shape is not valid: the boundary must not cross itself.
errors.FIELD_HAS_ACTIVE_CROP: This field has a crop in progress. Finish or cancel the crop plan first.
errors.FILE_NOT_FOUND: The attached file was not found. Upload it again.
errors.INVALID_PARENT: The main barn is not valid.
errors.FACILITY_OCCUPIED: {{occupiedHead}} animals are kept here. Move them first.
errors.INVALID_FIELD: One of the linked fields was not found.
errors.EXPIRY_BEFORE_ISSUE: The expiry date cannot be before the issue date.
errors.ENTITY_INCOMPLETE: The object this document links to is incomplete.

satellite.title: Crop health from space
satellite.refreshPending: Images are coming in; the rest are read tonight.
satellite.refreshNothing: No new clear image since the last check.
satellite.unavailable: The satellite catalogue is not responding. The nightly check will try again.
satellite.noBoundaryTitle: Draw the field to see it from space
satellite.noBoundaryBody: Crop health is read for the field's outline. Draw it on the farm map.
satellite.emptyBody: Sentinel-2 passes every 2 to 5 days. The first readings appear after tonight's check.
satellite.emptyCloudy: The last image, on {{date}}, was too cloudy over this field. The next pass comes in 2 to 5 days.
satellite.spreadHint: The closer the two, the more even the field.
satellite.clear: {{value}}% of the field clear of cloud
satellite.credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data {{year}}. 10 m per cell.
satellite.zonesHint: Parts of the field well below the rest. Walk there and look for pests, dry or waterlogged soil, poor emergence or missing fertiliser.
satellite.taskBody: Satellite image of {{date}}: {{area}} with NDVI {{ndvi}}, well below the rest of the field. Coordinates: {{lat}}, {{lng}}. Directions: {{link}}

position.unsupported: This device cannot share its location.
position.denied: Location access is off. Allow it for this site to walk to the zone.
position.unavailable: Your location is not available right now. Step into the open and try again.

satellite.curveHint: Mean NDVI of the field on each clear image.

no_green_up.title: No crop seen since sowing
no_green_up.body: Sown on {{date}}, but the satellite still sees bare soil. Check the emergence, or correct the sowing date.

harvest_not_seen.title: Harvest recorded, crop still standing
harvest_not_seen.body: A harvest is recorded on {{date}}, but the satellite still sees a green crop. Check the record.

unrecorded_harvest.title: Crop removed, no harvest recorded
unrecorded_harvest.body: Around {{date}} the satellite saw the crop removed (harvest, cutting or defoliation). Record the harvest if it took place.

pasture.title: Grazing on this pasture
pasture.hint: Green feed on {{area}}, estimated from the satellite image.
pasture.needSamples: 3 samples make it this farm's own
pasture.assumptions: Each animal eats {{intake}} kg of dry matter a day, and {{share}}% of the grass is grazed so the pasture regrows. Without samples the estimate assumes bare soil at NDVI 0.15 and 3,000 kg/ha at NDVI 0.75. Dry summer grass looks bare from space.
pasture.howTo: Cut all grass in a 1 × 1 m square to the ground, dry it in the sun until it crumbles, and weigh it. Grams per square metre × 10 = kg per hectare.
pasture.emptyBody: Three cut-and-weigh samples on different dates turn the rough estimate into this pasture's own.
pasture.deleteBody: The sample of {{date}} will no longer calibrate the estimate.

water.pageDescription: How much water each growing crop has used and when it needs the next watering, from the weather and the crop's growth stage (FAO-56).
water.title: Water balance
water.store: {{used}} mm used of {{raw}} mm the crop takes up easily ({{taw}} mm in the root zone in all)
water.assumptions: The advice assumes the root zone was full at sowing, as after pre-sowing watering, and that rain under a fifth of the day's water use evaporates. Record every watering with its m³ so the balance stays true.
water.emptyBody: Watering advice starts when a crop plan has a sowing date and the status sown or growing.

crop_unknown.title: No water data for this crop
crop_unknown.body: The advice covers wheat, barley, cotton, corn, alfalfa and rice.

no_sowing_date.title: Sowing date missing
no_sowing_date.body: Enter the actual sowing date in the crop plan.

not_sown_yet.title: Not sown yet
not_sown_yet.body: The balance starts on the sowing date.

season_over.title: Season over
season_over.body: The crop has passed the end of its season.

flooded.title: Flooded crop
flooded.body: Rice stands in water, so only its water use is shown.

no_soil_texture.title: Soil texture missing
no_soil_texture.body: Water use is known, but how much the soil holds is not. Set the soil texture on the field.

no_weather.title: Not enough weather data
no_weather.body: Weather for a day since sowing is not in yet. Observed weather is published 3 to 5 days late, so a new farm waits a few days; the weather check fills the gap by itself. If the farm's location is not set, set it in the farm passport.
